_comment: Approved FICTIONAL test data for the pre-human-review gate (scripts/gate_scan.py). Author: Chakravardhan. PROTECTED: any change sets gate_config_touched and needs a code owner. Every phone number, patient name and date of birth in tests/, tests/golden/ and clinic-api/seed.py must appear here; a scanner finding outside this list fails the gate. India has no reserved 'fictional' mobile range, so NEW fixtures must use phone_ranges (9000000000-9000009999) -- the explicit phones below are placeholder patterns (sequential or repeated digits) already used by the existing suite, listed one by one so that adding another needs owner approval. Never add a number, name or date copied from a real patient or caller.
